title: Sensitivity and Specificity of the Boston Criteria Version 2.0 for the Diagnosis of Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy in a Community-Based Sample
archive_note: ROSMAP autopsy cohort; v2.0 sensitivity 38.8% and specificity 83.5% for probable CAA.

title: Boston Criteria v2.0 for Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy Without Hemorrhage: An MRI-Neuropathologic Validation Study
archive_note: Mayo community/memory cohort; probable CAA sensitivity 28.6%, specificity 65.3%, AUC 0.47.

title: Fluid biomarkers in cerebral amyloid angiopathy: current limitations and future directions
archive_note: Current review concludes that no fluid marker has sufficient specificity and validation for routine CAA diagnosis.

title: Cerebrovascular reactivity MRI as a biomarker for cerebral small vessel disease-related cognitive decline: Multi-site validation in the MarkVCID Consortium
archive_note: Predefined multisite analysis; N=263; CVR was associated with global and executive cognition across sites.

title: Amyloid-related imaging abnormalities in anti-amyloid therapies for Alzheimer's disease: an update from the Alzheimer's Association ARIA workgroup
archive_note: Current workgroup synthesis of ARIA mechanisms, detection, monitoring, risk mitigation, and evidence gaps.

title: Main features of hereditary cerebral amyloid angiopathies: a systematic review
archive_note: Maps genetics, pathogenesis, neuroimaging, neuropathology, and clinical manifestations of hereditary CAA.

title: Clinical, neuroimaging, and genetic markers in cerebral amyloid angiopathy-related inflammation: a systematic review and meta-analysis
archive_note: Twenty-one cohorts and 378 patients; pooled clinical and imaging feature prevalence with substantial heterogeneity for many estimates.

title: Blood-based biomarkers of cerebral small vessel disease
archive_note: Reviews endothelial, inflammatory, oxidative, pericyte, and cardiovascular biomarker candidates; emphasizes validation needs.

title: Cerebral amyloid angiopathy and amyloid load distribution detected on amyloid-positron emission tomography: a systematic review and meta-analysis
archive_note: Sixteen prospective cohorts and 271 CAA participants; regional PET patterns are promising but require pathology-linked validation.

title: Association of cerebrovascular reactivity with 1-year imaging and clinical outcomes in small vessel disease: an observational cohort study
archive_note: Mild Stroke Study 3; 163 participants with adequate baseline CVR and follow-up MRI; lower CVR predicted WMH and PVS progression but not 1-year clinical outcomes.

title: Clinical-radiological spectrum of cerebral amyloid angiopathy-related inflammation
archive_note: Compared 37 CAA-ri and 158 non-inflammatory sporadic CAA cases; ARIA-E features were much more frequent in CAA-ri.
